import json, random, sys, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/vendor'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen, verify, controller

def main():
    seed0 = int(sys.argv[1]); n = int(sys.argv[2])
    bad=0; t0=time.time(); slow=0
    for i in range(n):
        rng = random.Random(seed0+i)
        J=rng.randint(5,40); S=rng.randint(3,25); F=rng.randint(1,8); G=rng.randint(0,5)
        c = gen.gen_case(rng, J=J,S=S,F=F,G=G, tmax=rng.choice([20,200,1000,10**9]))
        req = {'version':3,'cases':[c]}
        s=time.time()
        resp = controller.run(json.dumps(req).encode())
        dt=time.time()-s
        if dt>2: slow+=1; print('slow %.2f'%dt, J,S,F,G)
        try:
            verify.check_request(req, resp)
        except Exception as e:
            bad+=1
            print('FAIL', seed0+i, type(e).__name__, str(e)[:200])
            if bad>5: break
    print('trials',n,'bad',bad,'slow',slow,'%.1fs'%(time.time()-t0))
main()
PYEOF
